verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs show that instances are region-specific: there is a separate MCP server per region, plus a distinct Vanta Gov (FedRAMP) environment at api.vanta-gov.com. That implies regional data hosting, but nothing documents how a customer picks a region at signup. Missing for 10: documentation of customer-selectable region at provisioning, a list of available regions, explicit data-residency guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Vanta hosts a separate MCP server in each region. Find the region for your Vanta instance and use that URL.
Select `Vanta Gov (FedRAMP)` from the server dropdown to issue requests against `https://api.vanta-gov.com`.
